## Earn Credits

Users earn credits by contributing to Interview Intelligence.

| Action | Credits Earned |
|--------|---------------|
| Share interview session for community use | +1 |
| Submit Q&A from external interview | +1 |
| Report interview outcome (passed / rejected / offered) | +2 |
| Your submitted answer gets 5+ upvotes | +1 |
| Your question gets 3+ verifications | +0.5 |
| Refer a friend who signs up and contributes | +3 (each) |
